title: Four Poses of Armored Warrior
description: Four identical views of a female character with short white hair, displayed sequentially from left to right. She wears a brown and black armored corset with shoulder pads, blue pants with knee guards, and brown boots, performing a progressive combat stance with arms extended forward in a defensive or striking pose.
prompt: A female warrior with short cropped white hair and intense expression, wearing a brown leather and metal armored corset, black sleeves, blue pants with reinforced knee pads, and brown boots.
